title: Persistent blind SSRF: stored DestUrl is POSTed without re-validation and redirects are followed
owner_hint: top committer: Aditya Mandaleeka (1 of 1 recent commit); no CODEOWNERS entry
rationale: Stored DestUrl is POSTed with no delivery-time validation while the default client follows redirects. The diff adds a shared validator, validates before dispatch, registers a named client with AllowAutoRedirect=false, UseProxy=false and a ConnectCallback that re-resolves and only connects to public addresses, and applies the same client to the grant tester.
variants_checked: Sender and grant tester both use the safe client; other clients use fixed internal base addresses.
bypass_considered: Redirect and proxy pivots are closed; DNS rebinding is closed because ConnectCallback connects to the specific validated IP. Residual: a public IP that the platform NATs inward, or IPv4-translated IPv6 forms not matched by the ::/96 test.
test_note: Added WebhookSenderSsrfTests asserting a stored metadata DestUrl never reaches the handler.
review_reason: Validation runs before dispatch and ConnectCallback re-resolves and pins the public address at connect time, closing the rebind/redirect/proxy bypasses. No validation is weakened; the grant-tester hunk is the same SSRF class on the same subscription flow and reuses the safe client.
